changelog:
## Aura Cascade Reimagined 0.2.1 Beta

Minecraft 1.21.11 / Fabric. Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Java 21, Fabric API, and Patchouli: Fabric Edition 1.21.11-94.4-FABRIC. Fabric API and Patchouli are external required dependencies; Team Reborn Energy API 4.2.0 is bundled. Use a new world or a backed-up trial: old 0.1.x world compatibility is not established. Do not downgrade worlds opened by 1.21.11.

- Carries forward the 0.2.1 hotfixes: dropped-item crafting particles, empty-node connection previews, Aura Creative tab discoverability with later selection retention, stable Aura HUD rows, and nine separate Encyclopedia landing links.
- White Aura Crystals use one Amethyst Shard surrounded by eight Gold Nuggets, yielding two crystals.
- Adapts saved data, registrations, recipes, rendering and gameplay hooks to 1.21.11; corrects target HUD/storage text opacity and the invisible Fairy Torch particle texture.
- Bounded validation includes 258 tests across 65 suites, 11 publishing-utility tests, 15 multiplayer checks, three transformed-item lifetime checks, 18 landing-link assertions, actual-font guide layout, visual feedback/render checks, native persistence, changed gameplay hooks, a fueled White Ingot cycle, a complete White Gem Vortex craft and a third-party energy receiver.

Fixtures supply materials and controlled starting states. This is not exhaustive Survival or modpack testing. All fairy-role combinations, natural Scarer spawn rates, a full target Prism cycle and long-duration Red Hole expiry remain outside this validation. Known inherited issue: the Breeder Fairy may select juvenile animals; this forward port does not fix the issue reproduced on canonical 1.21.1.

Unofficial modern port of Aura Cascade by pixlepix; original 1.8.x port by williewillus. Original texture credits and MIT notices are retained.
